verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS work tracker, so headless or CI-driven operation is a fair axis. Its documented REST v3 API is explicitly offered to "automate even more of your workspace's workflow," and Swagger/OpenAPI specs are available, so the product can be driven without its UI. However, nothing documents a dedicated CLI, CI integration (such as a CI action or pipeline recipe), or token guidance for non-interactive runs, and the probed OpenAPI spec URLs returned 404. missing for 10: official CLI or CI-specific tooling, documented headless/CI usage guides, reachable machine-readable spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use this API to build custom integrations or automate even more of your workspace’s workflow.
We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
